user.title: Add a Hydros device
user.description: Enter your CoralVue provider key and the device key generated for this device or collective in the HYDROS app. See [Getting your API keys]({keys_url}).

data.name: Name (leave blank to use the collective/device name)

add_another.title: Add another device?
add_another.description: Each Hydros device or collective has its own device key. Add another one to this entry now, or finish.

reauth_keys.title: Update API keys
reauth_keys.description: Hydros rejected the API keys for "{device}". Enter the new key(s), or leave a field blank to keep the current one.

reauth_device.title: Re-authenticate device
reauth_device.description: The Hydros integration now uses API keys instead of your account login. Enter a provider/device key pair for the device previously known as "{thing_id}". See [Getting your API keys]({keys_url}).

data.name: Name (leave blank to use the collective/device name)

error.invalid_auth: The provided API key is invalid.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Hydros service.
error.already_configured: This Hydros device is already configured.
error.wrong_device: These keys belong to a different Hydros device.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Check Home Assistant's logs for details.

abort.already_in_progress: This Hydros device is already being set up.
